### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx`  _(via getPresignedUrl (sdk, the bare tail of client method storage.getPresignedUrl, bound to POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned), storage.getPresignedUrl (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned))_
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/storage-service.mdx`  _(via getPresignedUrl (sdk, the bare tail of client method storage.getPresignedUrl, bound to POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d6c0a75f1a4ebdc6c4cf81865226bf72db9f29f6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2b06dfa2f04658ed7a0f07acaadbb531402d422e` — the merge of head `4293804621b82769ea8a42241aeb0c5b833c20ca` into base `d6c0a75f1a4ebdc6c4cf81865226bf72db9f29f6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2b06dfa2f04658ed7a0f07acaadbb531402d422e && git checkout 2b06dfa2f04658ed7a0f07acaadbb531402d422e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d6c0a75f1a4ebdc6c4cf81865226bf72db9f29f6 4293804621b82769ea8a42241aeb0c5b833c20ca && git checkout -B drift-repro d6c0a75f1a4ebdc6c4cf81865226bf72db9f29f6 && git merge --no-ff 4293804621b82769ea8a42241aeb0c5b833c20ca

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d6c0a75f1a4ebdc6c4cf81865226bf72db9f29f6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d6c0a75f1a4ebdc6c4cf81865226bf72db9f29f6` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4293804621b82769ea8a42241aeb0c5b833c20ca`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts + packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts, packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.test.ts, packages/spec/src/api/storage.test.ts

Inputs read: card #27598 (body and all 5 comments, the seat's claim correction 6524182832 included), PR #28136 body, file list and the three-dot diff `origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-f1kiqr` (merge-base `d6c0a75f`, main at `277275aa`), and the 59 check-runs on the head. Faces: `reviewFace` on the file list returns the schema face (`hits` = `packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts`); the PR body and changeset also declare `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, so the narrowing floor adds every non-prose path. The changeset and `content/docs/references/api/storage.mdx` are the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; ② below reads the changeset's declaration lines and level only.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.size` accept set narrows from any JSON number to a non-negative integer (`z.number().int().min(0)`). RIGHT against the ruling (card: "`int().min(0)`") and against the door: `isDeclaredByteCount` on the head asks `typeof size === 'number'`, `Number.isInteger(size)` and that `size` is at least 0 (`storage-routes.ts:174-176`), so `-1`, `1.5`, `-0.5`, `NaN`, `Infinity`, `'100'` and `true` are refused by both. One residual edge is ④ S1.
2. `filename` / `mimeType` narrow from `z.string()` to `z.string().min(1)`. RIGHT: the door's presence check `!filename || !mimeType || size == null` (`storage-routes.ts:970`) has refused `''` with `400 INVALID_REQUEST` and written no row; the declared increment the claim conditioned on that measurement is met in the live tree, and the new door test pins it. Whitespace-only values stay admitted by both, as on the #27887 sibling.
3. The public TS type `GetPresignedUrlRequest = z.input` stays `string` / `string` / `number`: no TS consumer moves. RIGHT: `packages/client/src/index.ts:5369-5373` and `:5436` compile unchanged, and the four Type Check jobs on the head are green.
4. The door's accept set narrows in one place: a fractional `size` moves from `200` (URL minted, pending `sys_file` row written) to `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, before `store.createFile`. RIGHT, and a narrowing in the same direction as the declaration, so the two refuse the same set for every realistic value. Status, code and ordering (presence, byte count, scope, upload limit) are unchanged for every other value; only the refusal text moves ("a non-negative whole number"), and no file outside `storage-routes.ts` / its test pins the old text (`git grep` on `origin/main`: none).
5. Published JSON Schema: `size` becomes `integer` with `minimum 0`; `filename` / `mimeType` gain `minLength 1`. RIGHT; the regenerated reference table (`storage.mdx:226` now `integer`, descriptions "(non-empty)") agrees. No other committed artefact records constraints: `json-schema.manifest`, `api-surface`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins`, `authorable-surface`, `authorable-defaults` list ids, keys and defaults only, so none is stale; the Lint gates that carry `check:generated` are green on the head.
6. No key added, removed, renamed or tombstoned; `UploadScope`, `scope` default and `bucket` untouched; `CompleteUploadRequestSchema` and `heldBytesRefusal` untouched. RIGHT: the authorable-surface ledger needs no change and gets none.
7. Public surface outside `packages/spec`: `@objectstack/service-storage` exports no new symbol; `isDeclaredByteCount` and `PRESIGNED_SIZE_REFUSAL_MESSAGE` stay module-private. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/27598-presigned-size-whole-non-negative.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/service-storage` patch; `fix(spec)!` with the BREAKING banner; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at line starts; one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- Clause-②: `no (narrowing)` is RIGHT. The diff widens nothing (①.6) and narrows a published accept set (①.1, ①.2, ①.4), so the arm is owed; the PR body carries the same line. The seat's correction 6524182832 keeps the claim's bare `no` as the truthful value and the arm as the breaking signal, which is how `clause2-line.mjs` reads it (the arm is the first token in the parentheses; the trailing " — ..." prose after it is permitted).
- Level: `none` + patch is RIGHT under ruling A as written in `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and the pr-automation level table: "`Metadata-protocol: none` — no change to what a metadata author can write: the level is `patch`, REST, drivers, services, ... `fix!:` alike". `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema` is a REST request body no metadata type embeds; nothing an author writes changes. The script's own battery names this exact pair ("`no (narrowing)` with `none` beside it ships `patch`"). The #27887 sibling (`InitiateChunkedUploadRequestSchema`, merged 2026-10-30T03:34Z) carried the same pair. The head commit `4293804` is the regrade from `minor` + `narrowed` to this pair.
- ADR-0087: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` holds. The refused values never named a completable upload (a fraction cannot equal a held byte count; `''` was already refused), so there is nothing for a migration to rewrite and no tombstone. The #22470 precedent (`semantic/18.upload-request-scope-closed.ts`) registered an entry because callers had to choose a new vocabulary; here no caller choice exists. The gate step "Require an ADR-0087 disposition on a declared-breaking changeset" is green on every run of `Check Changeset` on this head, the failed one included.
- Gate verdict: `Check Changeset` ran three times on this head: 2026-10-30T13:41Z failure at step 13 "Guard against accidental major bumps (launch window)", then 2026-10-30T13:50Z and 2026-10-30T13:53Z success after the body edit. The newest run of the name governs: green. (The failed job's log blob is not reachable from this seat; its step roster is, and the ADR-0087 step passed.)

### ③ Boundary flags

- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note owed.
- `open_questions[0]` (keep `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` though the claim wrote bare `no`): ANSWERED by seat correction 6524182832, option A; the head carries the arm on body and changeset. Right (②).
- `open_questions[1]` (`narrowed` + minor vs `none` + patch): ANSWERED by the same correction, option B (`none`); implemented in `4293804`; `Check Changeset` green after the body edit. Right (②).
- `deviations[0]` (first push refused, local branch renamed to the thread branch): mechanics only; `Implemented-by` below names the branch the diff lives on.
- `deviations[1]` (arm differs from the claim): same as `open_questions[0]`.
- `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (SDK `storage.upload` sends `mimeType: file.type`, which is `''` for a browser File of unknown type, so the presigned door answers `400`): ESCALATED. Confirmed in the live tree (`packages/client/src/index.ts:5371`); pre-existing, not moved by this diff, and the changeset's remedy sentence ("an unknown type is sent as `application/octet-stream`") describes a behaviour the SDK helper does not have. Owes a card on `packages/client` (`storage.upload` falls back to `application/octet-stream`); not a finding on this PR.
- `out_of_scope_findings[1]` (dogfood `api-action-door-forward` main-red candidate): RESOLVED on `origin/main` at `277275aa`: the test now asserts `expect(message).not.toContain('sys_metadata_activation')` (`:183`). No card owed.
- Check-runs on the head: 59; per name the newest run is success or skipped; the Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, PR-body guards, all Lint, Type Check, Build and the eight Test Core shards are green. Dogfood Regression Gate shards were skipped by the path filter on this PR; `git grep` on `origin/main` finds no dogfood or integration test that sends a fractional `size` or an empty `filename` / `mimeType` to `/storage/upload/presigned`, so the narrowing reaches no skipped suite.
- Auto-merge: not armed. `needs:contract-review` is on the PR; a PASS on this head strips it.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts` (hits) — against the card's ruling (`int().min(0)`), the first consumer (`POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned`, `storage-routes.ts:965-1046`) and the SDK (`packages/client/src/index.ts`):
- Holds. The declaration now names the set the door enforces for every JSON value a client produces; `File.size` is a whole number and the three descriptions read true. The comment cites #27801 / the chunked-init sibling, whose `filename` / `mimeType` lines are byte-identical, so the two request schemas read as one convention.
- S1, should-fix: `@objectstack/spec` pins `zod ^4.6.6` (lockfile `zod@4.6.7`), where `.int()` is the safe-integer format: the schema refuses a `size` above `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` while the door's `Number.isInteger` admits it, and with no settings namespace bound (`maxUploadBytes` undefined, `storage-limits.ts:228` admits any size) the door mints a URL for a value the declaration refuses — the same declared-versus-enforced class this PR closes for fractions, in the other direction. Reach is nil in practice (a declared size of 9 PB), so not a FAIL. Remedy: `Number.isSafeInteger(size)` in `isDeclaredByteCount` and one refusal-table row (`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2`), or a description that says the schema's integer is a safe integer.

`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts` (narrowing floor) — against `heldBytesRefusal` (`:1976-1992`) and the #22470 ordering rule:
- Holds. `Number.isInteger` is the whole change; the presence check, the byte-count check, the scope gate and the upload-limit check keep their order, so #22470's "presence before scope" stands and the refusal code is the one the door already used. The docblock's account (a fraction minted a URL and a pending row the complete door could never match, because `getInfo(key).size` is whole) is what the cited code does.

`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.test.ts` (narrowing floor):
- Holds. Each refusal row and both CONTROL rows now also ask the declaration the same question, so the test pins declaration and door to the same answer on every value it names; `createFile` is spied to pin "no row written". The empty-key test asserts status and code but not the presence-check message; acceptable, since the message is unchanged and pinned nowhere else either.

`packages/spec/src/api/storage.test.ts` (narrowing floor):
- Holds. Refusals name the key and, for the strings, the `too_small` code; controls cover `0`, `1`, `1048576`. The `issues.toHaveLength(1)` assertions bind the test to zod reporting one issue for `-0.5` (`int` before `min`); green on this zod, a test-shape risk only, not a contract one.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: S1.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 预签名上传请求的 schema（`GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema`）现在声明 `size` 必须是非负整数，`filename`、`mimeType` 不能为空。上传入口同时开始拒收小数字节数，返回 400 INVALID_REQUEST。
- **为什么改：** 公开 schema 原来接受负数、小数和空字符串，入口却拒收负数和空值，按 schema 写代码的调用方或 AI 会被误导。小数更糟：入口原来会签发上传地址，并写一条永远无法完成的待上传记录。
- **风险与回滚：** 负数、非数字、空文件名或空类型的入口行为不变。唯一的行为变化是小数 `size` 从 200 变成 400，正常客户端发的 `File.size` 本来就是整数。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts` 的三处收窄；`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts` 的 `isDeclaredByteCount`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/storage.test.ts`，预期 73 个测试全过。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，席内契约复审 PASS（评论 6525353405），由席位落地。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · 2026-10-30T14:37Z

Head `4293804621b82769ea8a42241aeb0c5b833c20ca`. Card #27598, claim 6521786446, claim correction 6524182832. The maintainer's rulings, verbatim: 「你有 fable，可以自己契约复审」 and 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft to `main`, made by the relay. The body has `Fixes #27598`. The seat patched the body to `Metadata-protocol: none`, and its first line is now the seat signature, above the attribution block. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` sit line-initial on both the body and the changeset. Spec and service-storage are both `patch`, and the ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- **Contract review:** record 6525353405, in-seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by an at-tier reviewer that was not the drafter. It is a PASS with no must-fix.
- **Accepted deviation:** the claim wrote `Clause-②: no`. The tree, body and changeset carry `no (narrowing)`, per the order and triage 6500594085. The correction 6524182832 set the protocol line to `none`.
- **Should-fix S1 dropped:** zod 4 `.int()` refuses a `size` above `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` while the door's `Number.isInteger` admits it. The reach is a 9 PB declaration, so there is no user-visible cost and no card.
- **Gates:** the newest run of every check on this head is success or skipped, and the Check Changeset re-run from this act's label change is the last one pending. `mergeable_state` is clean. `check-governed-merges --pr 28136`: NOT governed, +101/−17.
- **Body lag, noted rather than patched:** the Verification block names `902d10c0` and says CI was not yet read. The storage suites, dogfood and gates were re-run on `42938046` by the dev (thread report). The tree is what the review judged.
- **Out of scope:**
  - The SDK's `storage.upload` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`) sends `mimeType: file.type`, which is `''` for a browser `File` of unknown type, so the door refuses the upload. This is pre-existing and belongs to the client package. The seat routes it as a card.
  - The dogfood main-red candidate is already fixed on `main` (#28095).
  - `Skills-docs:` not owed.
- **Landing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` once the Check Changeset re-run is green.
